summary: Small Annunciation panel in the Louvre (MI 598), central part of the predella of the Verrocchio altarpiece for Pistoia Cathedral, catalogued by the Louvre as Lorenzo di Credi.

timeline.text: Predella panel of the Verrocchio altarpiece for Pistoia Cathedral. Its attribution is divided between Lorenzo di Credi and the young Leonardo.
timeline.basis: Louvre dating of the altarpiece; attribution disputed.

claims.statement: The Louvre lists L'Annonciation, MI 598, attributed to Lorenzo di Credi, former attribution Leonardo da Vinci.
